text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good leaders follow a few simple rules. First, clear communication is essential, because team members need to understand their goals and tasks. Second, delegation helps a lot: a good manager trusts the team and shares responsibilities instead of doing everything alone. Third, regular feedback supports people and helps them improve. Motivation also matters, so leaders should recognise good work and encourage their team. Finally, when conflicts appear, a manager should listen to both sides and solve the problem calmly. With these skills, any team can work well together and reach its goals.
